data.name: MEDA Environmental Monitoring

data.limitations: MEDA is a point-measurement instrument at the rover location, not a global map. Calibrated PDS products are not yet downloaded, parsed or displayed. No current temperature, pressure, wind or radiation values are represented.

data.name: MRO HiRISE, Jezero Mosaic, Controlled
data.description: High-resolution visible orthomosaic of Jezero Crater generated from HiRISE images and delivered through NASA Mars Trek as a WMTS layer. The product was produced by the USGS Astrogeology Science Center in support of the Mars 2020 terrain-relative navigation basemap.
data.processing_level: Orthomosaic; controlled product (Mars 2020 terrain-relative navigation basemap).
data.limitations: The product label states 25 cm/pixel. Mars Trek catalog metadata lists data_created_date 2020-08-03 as the product creation date, not the acquisition date of every contributing HiRISE image; per-image acquisition dates are not exposed by this layer. Bounding box order is west, south, east, north in degrees. Verify the PDS product before scientific use.
data.attribution: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona · USGS Astrogeology Science Center · NASA Mars Trek
